The convergence allows Vcom to leverage predictive analytics and AI-driven monitoring tools across both its IT applications and network hardware, proactively identifying and resolving potential bottlenecks before they impact the end-user experience. An analysis of the projected cross-selling revenue for Vcom and Aiguille Security in South Africa between 2020 and 2024 reveals a consistently positive growth trajectory. In 2020, the estimated revenue generated from these cross-selling initiatives stood at a minimum value of 15.0 Million ZAR. Over the subsequent four years, this figure experienced substantial year-over-year growth, ultimately reaching a maximum value of 80.0 Million ZAR in 2024.
